title: By how much did Chintamani grow in thirteen years?
description: A question from the book gives the population of Chintamani in twenty eleven and in twenty twenty four, and asks by how much it increased. The video finds the increase by hopping through one lakh, and checks it by adding back.
teaching_notes: One idea: an increase is the later value take away the earlier value, and a stop at one lakh splits the hop into two easy parts. Ask the class to add the increase back to the earlier population and see whether the later one returns. Watch for students who subtract in the wrong order or add the two populations.

source: Figure it Out, Q3 (growth of Chintamani)
video_script.why: The child can find how far a number is below and above one lakh, and now joins the two gaps.
video_script.substitution: An increase is the later value take away the earlier value, found by hopping through one lakh.
video_script.anchor: The population of Chintamani was about seventy five thousand in twenty eleven and is estimated at one lakh six thousand in twenty twenty four: by how much did it increase?
video_script.payoff_line: The population increased by thirty one thousand
video_script.design: One idea: an increase is the later value take away the earlier value, and the stop at one lakh splits the hop into two parts. The method of the rice question is reused: compare with one lakh by subtracting. The anchor stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part; no hard clear.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, the later value is one lakh six thousand.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, hop through one lakh. From seventy five thousand to one lakh is twenty five thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>From one lakh to one lakh six thousand is six thousand.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, check by putting the hops back in the question. Seventy five thousand, plus twenty five thousand, plus six thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>That lands exactly on one lakh six thousand, so the hops are right.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>The two hops of twenty five thousand and six thousand together make thirty one thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The population increased by thirty one thousand.
